subject: Mathematics
title: Limits, Continuity and Differentiability
summary: Limit batata hai ki x ke a ke paas jaane par f(x) kis value ke paas jaata hai; ye tab exist karta hai jab left-hand aur right-hand limits barabar aur finite hon.
Indeterminate forms (0/0, ∞/∞, 1^∞, 0 × ∞, ∞ − ∞) factorisation, rationalisation, standard limits, series expansion ya L'Hôpital's rule se solve hote hain.
f, a par continuous hai agar lim f(x) = f(a). f, a par differentiable hai agar left aur right derivatives barabar hon; differentiability se continuity milti hai, par ulta nahi (|x| at 0).

formulas.name: Existence of a limit
formulas.when: Break points par limits check karna.

formulas.name: Trigonometric limits
formulas.formula: lim sin x/x = 1;  lim tan x/x = 1;  lim (1 − cos x)/x² = 1/2  (x → 0, radians)
formulas.mistake: x radians mein hona chahiye — degrees mein mat lagaana.

formulas.name: Exponential and log limits
formulas.formula: lim (eˣ − 1)/x = 1;  lim (aˣ − 1)/x = ln a;  lim ln(1 + x)/x = 1  (x → 0)

formulas.name: 1^∞ form
formulas.formula: lim f^g = e^{lim g(f − 1)} when f → 1, g → ∞;  lim (1 + 1/x)ˣ = e;  lim (1 + x)^{1/x} = e

formulas.name: L'Hôpital's rule
formulas.formula: for 0/0 or ∞/∞: lim f/g = lim f′/g′
formulas.when: Jab standard limits fit na hon.
formulas.mistake: Numerator aur denominator alag-alag differentiate karo — quotient ko nahi.

formulas.name: Series expansions
formulas.formula: eˣ = 1 + x + x²/2! + …;  sin x = x − x³/3! + …;  cos x = 1 − x²/2! + …;  ln(1 + x) = x − x²/2 + …;  tan x = x + x³/3 + …

formulas.name: Rational functions at infinity
formulas.formula: degree num < den → 0;  equal → ratio of leading coefficients;  num > den → ±∞

formulas.name: Continuity
formulas.formula: f continuous at a ⇔ lim (x→a) f(x) = f(a)

formulas.name: Differentiability
formulas.formula: Lf′(a) = lim (h→0⁻) (f(a + h) − f(a))/h;  Rf′(a) similarly;  differentiable ⇔ Lf′(a) = Rf′(a)
formulas.mistake: Differentiable ⇒ continuous, par continuous ⇏ differentiable (|x| at 0) — ulta mat lagaana.

formulas.name: Sandwich theorem
formulas.formula: g(x) ≤ f(x) ≤ h(x) and lim g = lim h = L ⇒ lim f = L

examples.title: Continuity condition
examples.problem: x ≠ 1 ke liye f(x) = (x³ − 1)/(x − 1) aur f(1) = k. Continuity ke liye k nikalo.

topics.title: Rationalisation
topics.explain: (√(x + 1) − 1)/x jaise square root wale limits mein conjugate se multiply karke 0/0 form hatao.

topics.title: Limits at infinity with roots
topics.explain: x → ∞ par √(x² + x) − x ke liye rationalise karke x/(√(x² + x) + x) → 1/2 milta hai.

topics.title: Continuity of standard functions
topics.explain: Polynomials, sin, cos, eˣ har jagah continuous; rational functions jahan denominator 0 na ho; log x, x > 0 ke liye; [x] integers par discontinuous.

topics.title: Algebra of continuous functions
topics.explain: Continuous functions ka sum, difference, product aur composition continuous hai; quotient bhi, jahan denominator zero na ho.

topics.title: Intermediate value theorem
topics.explain: Agar f, [a, b] par continuous hai aur k, f(a) aur f(b) ke beech hai, to (a, b) mein kisi c ke liye f(c) = k — equation ka root dikhaane mein use hota hai.

topics.title: Non-differentiable points
topics.explain: Corners (|x − a|), cusps, vertical tangents (0 par x^{1/3}) aur discontinuities. |f(x)| wahan differentiable nahi ho sakta jahan f(x) = 0 ho aur sign badle.

topics.title: Real functions and their graphs
topics.explain: Syllabus yeh unit real-valued functions se shuru karta hai: algebra of functions (f ± g, fg, f/g jahan g ≠ 0, f∘g), polynomial, rational, trigonometric, exponential (aˣ) aur logarithmic (logₐx, domain x > 0) functions, aur inverse functions (sirf one-one onto f ke liye; f⁻¹ ka graph y = x line mein f ka mirror image). |x|, [x], {x}, sgn x, eˣ, ln x, sin x, cos x, tan x aur 1/x ke graph yaad rakho — inka domain, range aur jahan ye toot-te hain ya corner banate hain, wahi continuity aur differentiability ke zyaadatar answer dete hain.
